subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's new sessions.activity RPC, session.activity websocket event, and task/tool plugin hooks now, or keep activity API design behind the canonical session-activity issue until the contract is settled?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical correctness: these additions become public Gateway/protocol/plugin contracts and overlap an open canonical product/API design issue.

options.title: Narrow And Align Before Merge
options.body: Repair the selected-global scoping bug, resolve conflicts, and either align the public API with the canonical activity contract or defer the plugin hooks until maintainers accept them.

options.title: Approve The New Contract
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the proposed RPC, websocket event, and hook names now, then require focused compatibility and proof follow-through before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch if attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics should be decided in the canonical issue before any SDK contract lands.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Align Before Merge
recommendation.body: Repair the selected-global scoping bug, resolve conflicts, and either align the public API with the canonical activity contract or defer the plugin hooks until maintainers accept them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work and review history connect this person to the UI session matching and Gateway/plugin API surfaces most directly affected by the product decision.
